media_assets_location_ck.name: media_assets_location_ck
media_assets_location_ck.value: "media_assets"."storage_key" IS NOT NULL OR "media_assets"."remote_url" IS NOT NULL

media_assets_dimensions_ck.name: media_assets_dimensions_ck
media_assets_dimensions_ck.value: ("media_assets"."width" IS NULL OR "media_assets"."width" > 0) AND ("media_assets"."height" IS NULL OR "media_assets"."height" > 0)

posts_not_self_reference_ck.name: posts_not_self_reference_ck
posts_not_self_reference_ck.value: ("posts"."parent_post_id" IS NULL OR "posts"."parent_post_id" <> "posts"."id") AND ("posts"."quote_post_id" IS NULL OR "posts"."quote_post_id" <> "posts"."id")

posts_reference_shape_ck.name: posts_reference_shape_ck
posts_reference_shape_ck.value:
(
    ("posts"."kind" = 'post' AND "posts"."parent_post_id" IS NULL AND "posts"."quote_post_id" IS NULL) OR
    ("posts"."kind" = 'reply' AND "posts"."parent_post_id" IS NOT NULL AND "posts"."quote_post_id" IS NULL) OR
    ("posts"."kind" IN ('quote', 'repost') AND "posts"."parent_post_id" IS NULL AND "posts"."quote_post_id" IS NOT NULL)
  )

ai_generations_usage_ck.name: ai_generations_usage_ck
ai_generations_usage_ck.value: ("ai_generations"."tokens_in" IS NULL OR "ai_generations"."tokens_in" >= 0) AND ("ai_generations"."tokens_out" IS NULL OR "ai_generations"."tokens_out" >= 0) AND ("ai_generations"."cost_credits" IS NULL OR "ai_generations"."cost_credits" >= 0) AND ("ai_generations"."latency_ms" IS NULL OR "ai_generations"."latency_ms" >= 0)

budget_policies_scope_ck.name: budget_policies_scope_ck
budget_policies_scope_ck.value: ("budget_policies"."scope" = 'global' AND "budget_policies"."scope_id" IS NULL) OR ("budget_policies"."scope" = 'agent' AND "budget_policies"."scope_id" IS NOT NULL)
